• The 1,500 MW Virginia event that jolted the grid in milliseconds

From Nvidia H100 spikes to Google’s quantum breakthrough, this connects AI infrastructure strain to the race toward artificial super intelligence.

If AI keeps scaling on classical systems, what happens to the power grid before quantum computing catches up?
